list_directory.desc: List directory contents with sizes and modification timestamps. Use for detailed one-level listings or bounded recursive listings; use directory_tree for a structural overview. Output is capped by max_entries by default. In large projects, narrow with glob/exclude_patterns before raising limits.

params.path: Directory to list. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden entries (names starting with '.'). Default: false.
params.max_depth: Max recursion depth when recursive=true. Default: 3.
params.glob: Only show files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go, *.{ts,tsx}). Applies to files only; directories are still shown/traversed. Default: all files.
params.exclude_patterns: Glob patterns matched against each entry's basename (not full path). Useful with recursive=true to skip noisy directories such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, or generated logs.
params.max_entries: Maximum number of file/directory entries to output before truncating. Default: 500. Set 0 for unlimited.

create_directory.desc: Create a directory and all missing parents (equivalent to mkdir -p). No-op if the directory already exists.

delete_directory.desc: Delete a directory. IRREVERSIBLE. Must be empty unless force=true — which deletes the entire tree recursively. Confirm with the user before using force=true on directories that may contain important files.

params.force: Delete non-empty directories recursively. IRREVERSIBLE. Default: false.

directory_tree.desc: Print a recursive visual tree of files and directories with sizes. Best for understanding project structure at a glance. Output is capped by max_entries by default. Use exclude_patterns to skip large irrelevant subtrees before raising limits.

params.exclude_patterns: Glob patterns matched against each entry's basename (not full path). "node_modules" excludes any directory with that name at any depth; "*.log" excludes files like error.log.
params.glob: Only show files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go). Directories without matching descendants are pruned. Default: all files.
params.max_entries: Maximum number of file/directory entries to output before truncating. Default: 500. Set 0 for unlimited.
